title: Discount codes
brief: Customers can enter a discount code on an order. Codes: SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal (rounded down to a whole cent); FIVEOFF takes $5.00 (500 cents) off an order whose subtotal is at least $25.00 (2500 cents). Codes are case-insensitive. Shared contract for every job: an order object gains `discountCode` (the code in upper case, only when one was applied) and `discountCents` (always present; 0 when there's no code); `totalFor(order)` returns `subtotalCents - discountCents`, never below 0. An unknown code, or FIVEOFF under its minimum, is refused with an Error whose message names the code.

jobs.title: Discount rules
jobs.brief: Create src/discounts.js exporting `applyDiscount(subtotalCents, code)`, returning `{ code, discountCents }` for a valid code (code in upper case) and throwing for an unknown code or FIVEOFF under its $25.00 minimum, as the plan's brief says. With no code (undefined or empty), return `{ discountCents: 0 }`. Add test/discounts.test.js covering both codes, case-insensitivity, rounding, the minimum, and the refusals. Plain Node, CommonJS, no dependencies; run `npm test`.

jobs.title: Codes on orders and in the API
jobs.brief: Use applyDiscount from src/discounts.js: `createOrder(items, code)` in src/orders.js applies an optional code and stores `discountCode` and `discountCents` on the order as the plan's contract says; `totalFor(order)` subtracts `discountCents`. In src/api.js, POST /orders accepts an optional `code` in the body and answers 400 with the error's message for a refused code; responses keep `totalCents` from totalFor. Don't edit the tests; another job writes them.

jobs.title: Discount on the order page
jobs.brief: In src/ui.js, renderOrder shows a discount row above the total when `order.discountCents > 0`: `Discount (CODE)-$X.XX`, with the code from `order.discountCode`, escaped. The total row keeps using totalFor(order). Work from the plan's contract for the order's fields; another job changes src/orders.js. Don't edit the tests.

jobs.title: Tests for codes on orders and the API
jobs.brief: Add tests to test/orders.test.js and test/api.test.js: an order with SAVE10 and one with FIVEOFF (right discountCents, discountCode and total), no code (discountCents 0), a lower-case code, FIVEOFF under the minimum and an unknown code refused (400 from POST /orders with the code in the error). Keep the existing tests passing.

jobs.title: Tests for the order page's discount
jobs.brief: Add tests to test/ui.test.js: an order with a code renders the discount row (code and amount) and the discounted total; an order without one renders no discount row. Build orders with createOrder(items, code). Keep the existing test passing.

jobs.title: Document discount codes
jobs.brief: In README.md, document discount codes: the two codes and their rules, the optional `code` in POST /orders and its 400 for a refused code, the order's `discountCode`/`discountCents` fields, and the discount row on the order page.
